## Summary

This project designs and develops a multi-blade horizontal axis wind turbine intended to supply electricity to households in Talang Solok Regency, Jambi. It is part of a broader effort to bring renewable energy options to rural communities where grid access is unreliable or absent.

## Contribution

- Applied engineering design to a concrete rural energy problem.
- Brought together mechanical, electrical, and community considerations in one build.
- Provides a locally documented example of small-scale wind power in Jambi.
